The per-mission-type end conditions (the `0x45b9d0` branches, the wave wake `0x4b0f40`, the bound zeppelin/target/gate objects and the caller's player-down gate `0x4a09b6`) are static image analysis — provenance static, never verified_original; no original executable ran.
